```{r}
natstories_rts <- read.csv("../naturalstories/naturalstories_RTS/processed_RTs.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(word_length = nchar(word))
```

```{r}
natstories_rts_by_zone <- natstories_rts %>%
  summarise(
    RT_mean = mean(RT),
    RT_sd = sd(RT),
    lower = RT_mean - RT_sd,
    upper = RT_mean + RT_sd,
    .by = c(item, zone)
  ) %>%
  mutate(zone_s = scale(zone))
```

```{r}
ggplot(natstories_rts_by_zone, aes(y = RT_mean, x = zone)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "grey", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = RT_mean), color = "grey", linewidth = .5) +
  facet_wrap(~item, scales = "free_x", ncol = 5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(100, 900)) +
  labs(
    title = "RTs by position in story",
    x = "Word Position",
    y = "Reading Time"
  ) + 
  theme_bw()
```

Remove outliers as in Oh and Schuler (2023)

```{r}
natstories_rts_clean <- natstories_rts %>%
  filter(RT > 200 & RT < 2000) %>%
  filter(correct >= 4)
```

Fit regression model on zone only

```{r}
natstories_rts_by_zone_clean <- natstories_rts_clean %>%
  summarise(
    RT_mean = mean(RT),
    RT_sd = sd(RT),
    lower = RT_mean - RT_sd,
    upper = RT_mean + RT_sd,
    .by = c(item, zone)
  ) %>%
  mutate(zone_s = scale(zone))
zone_model = lmer(RT_mean ~ zone + (1 + zone |item), data = natstories_rts_by_zone_clean)
```

Predict reading times from regression model

```{r}
grid_data <- natstories_rts_by_zone_clean %>% dplyr::select(item, zone)
RTs_pred = predict(zone_model, newdata = grid_data)
```

Calculate effective slopes (estimate of zone plus random slope per item)

```{r}
slope_zone <- fixef(zone_model)["zone"]
slopes_by_item <- ranef(zone_model)$item["zone"] + slope_zone
label_data = data.frame(
  item = seq(1,10),
  slope = round(slopes_by_item$zone,3)
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = str_glue("β = {slope}")
  )
```

```{r}
# load and fix Souvik's naming conventions
natstories_ivs <- read.csv("../iv_values/naturalstories/iv_temp_125.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(item_id, language, strategy, dataset)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("n_valid")) %>%
  # FIX: Euclidean = sqrt(2 * cosine distance) per pair; keep cosine only
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("d_semantic_euclidean")) %>%
  mutate(item = as.integer(str_split_i(document_id, "_", 2))) %>%
  dplyr::select(!document_id) %>%
  # FIX (off-by-one): the IV file counts sentences from 0, the surprisal-derived sentence_id from 1
  mutate(sentence_id = sentence_index + 1L) %>%
  dplyr::select(!sentence_index)

# merge and scale
natstories_fit_df <- merge(x=natstories_fit_df, y=natstories_ivs, by = c("item", "sentence_id"), all.x = TRUE)
# FIX (off-by-one): with the correct join no reading-time row is left without IV values
stopifnot(sum(is.na(natstories_fit_df$d3_transition_mean)) == 0)
# gold mention counts (count_entities_ns.py); sent_id is 0-based like the IV file
natstories_counts <- read.csv("../gold_counts/naturalstories_entity_counts.csv") %>%
  transmute(item, sentence_id = sent_id + 1L, n_mentions, n_transitions, n_entities, ctx_n_mentions, ctx_n_entities,
            ctx_role_cost_per_transition, cum_role_cost_per_transition)
natstories_fit_df <- merge(x = natstories_fit_df, y = natstories_counts, by = c("item", "sentence_id"), all.x = TRUE)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(natstories_fit_df$ctx_n_mentions)) == 0)
natstories_fit_df <- natstories_fit_df %>%
  # d8_graph_min is the last IV column written by calculate_entity_iv.py (form / MLP transition and graph channels)
  mutate(across(c(sum_RT:d8_graph_min, n_mentions:cum_role_cost_per_transition), \(x) as.vector(scale(x)), .names = "{.col}_s"))
```

This yields worse r2 and worse model fit, thus we will accept the collinearity and use both variables

```{r}
iv_formula <- sum_RT ~ sum_surprisal_s + sentence_length_char_s + 
                              d1_recurrence_uniform_mean_s +
                              d1_recurrence_exponential_mean_s +
                              d2_new_head_mean_s +
                              d3_transition_mean_s +
                              d_lexical_1gram_mean_s +
                              d_lexical_2gram_mean_s +
                              d_lexical_3gram_mean_s +
                              d_pos_overlap_1gram_mean_s +
                              d_pos_overlap_2gram_mean_s +
                              d_pos_overlap_3gram_mean_s +
                              d_syntactic_dependency_1gram_mean_s +
                              d_syntactic_dependency_2gram_mean_s +
                              d_syntactic_dependency_3gram_mean_s +
                              d_semantic_cosine_mean_s + 
                              d3_transition_form_mean_s +   # form-bigram transition (GUM)
                              d8_graph_mean_s +             # entity-graph connection-profile distance
                              (1|WorkerId) + (1|item)
# the MLP cost variants (d3_transition_role_mlp_mean_s, d3_transition_form_mlp_mean_s) are in the IV file but are
# collinear with the bigram channels; they are compared by swapping them in, not added on top (see analysis/CLAUDE.md)

# gold mention-count model and the combined model (IV channels + counts): how much of the IV effect is mention counts
mention_formula <- sum_RT ~ sum_surprisal_s + sentence_length_char_s +
                            n_mentions_s + n_transitions_s + n_entities_s + ctx_n_mentions_s + ctx_n_entities_s +
                            ctx_role_cost_per_transition_s + cum_role_cost_per_transition_s +
                            (1|WorkerId) + (1|item)
# combined model = controls + the six ENTITY channels + the seven gold counts (the other IV channels are left out:
# the question is how much of the entity-IV effect is mention counts)
both_formula <- sum_RT ~ sum_surprisal_s + sentence_length_char_s +
                         d1_recurrence_uniform_mean_s + d1_recurrence_exponential_mean_s + d2_new_head_mean_s + d3_transition_mean_s +
                         d3_transition_form_mean_s + d8_graph_mean_s +
                         n_mentions_s + n_transitions_s + n_entities_s + ctx_n_mentions_s + ctx_n_entities_s +
                         ctx_role_cost_per_transition_s + cum_role_cost_per_transition_s +
                         (1|WorkerId) + (1|item)
```

```{r}
calc_test_loglik_gaussian <- function(model, test_data, response_var,
                                  allow_new_levels = TRUE, group_var = NULL) {
  
  mu_pred <- predict(model, newdata = test_data,
                     allow.new.levels = allow_new_levels)
  
  # sd of residuals
  resid_sd <- sigma(model)
  # FIX: the test fold holds UNSEEN levels of group_var (new readers or a new story), whose random intercept is
  # predicted as 0; the predictive variance for such rows is sigma^2 + var(intercept of group_var), not sigma^2
  if (!is.null(group_var)) {
    vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    tau2 <- sum(vc$vcov[vc$grp == group_var & vc$var1 == "(Intercept)" & is.na(vc$var2)])
    resid_sd <- sqrt(resid_sd^2 + tau2)
  }
  
  observed <- test_data[[response_var]]
  n <- nrow(test_data)
  
  # residual sum of squares
  # FIX: `test_data$Reaction` did not exist (sleepstudy leftover), so residual_ss was always 0 and the test
  # data never entered; the Gaussian log-density is -(n/2) log(2 pi) - (n/2) log sigma^2 - RSS / (2 sigma^2)
  residual_ss <- sum((observed - mu_pred)^2)
  
  log_lik <- -(n / 2) * log(2 * pi) - (n / 2) * log((resid_sd)^2) - (residual_ss / (2 * (resid_sd)^2))
  
  return(
    # sum(dnorm(observed, mean = mu_pred, sd = resid_sd, log = TRUE))
    log_lik
    )
}
```


```{r}
model_cross_val <- function(model_formula, df, group_var, num_folds=10, seed = 123){
  
  # FIX: reproducible folds
  set.seed(seed)
  # sample folds grouped by WorkerId
  groups <- unique(df[[group_var]])
  fold_map <- setNames(sample(rep(1:num_folds, length.out = length(groups))), groups)
  df$.fold <- fold_map[as.character(df[[group_var]])]
  
  cv_results <- vector("list", num_folds)
  fixef_results <- vector("list", num_folds)
  
  response_var <- all.vars(model_formula)[1]
  
  # create a dummy null model for r2 calculation
  null_formula <- make_null_formula(model_formula)
  
  for (i in 1:num_folds) {
    train_data <- df %>% filter(.fold != i)
    test_data  <- df %>% filter(.fold == i)
    
    null_fit <- lmer(null_formula, data = train_data)
    model_fit <- lmer(model_formula, data = train_data)
    model_log_lik <- calc_test_loglik_gaussian(model_fit, test_data, response_var, group_var = group_var)
    model_rmse <- calc_test_rmse(model_fit, test_data, response_var)
    model_r2 <- r2(model_fit, null_model = null_fit)

    cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i, log_lik = model_log_lik, rmse = model_rmse, 
      r2_marginal = as.numeric(model_r2$R2_marginal),
      r2_conditional = as.numeric(model_r2$R2_conditional)
    )
    
    fixef_results[[i]] <- tidy(model_fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      transmute(fold = i, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, 
                conf.low, conf.high)
  }
  
  cv_summary <- do.call(rbind, cv_results)
  fixef_summary <- do.call(rbind, fixef_results)
  # FIX: estimates, SEs and p-values from ONE fit on all the data (not averaged over folds)
  full_fit <- lmer(model_formula, data = df)
  fixef_full <- tidy(full_fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
  
  return(
    list(cv_summary = cv_summary, fixef_summary = fixef_summary, fixef_full = fixef_full)
  )
}
```

```{r}
i <- 1
natstories_fixef_results <- vector("list")
natstories_cv_results <- vector("list")

# the IV model, the gold mention-count model and the combined model (tagged by `formula`)
formulas <- list(iv = iv_formula, mention = mention_formula, both = both_formula)
for (fname in names(formulas)) {
for (m in unique(natstories_fit_df$model)) {
  for (c in unique(natstories_fit_df$checkpoint)) {
    # print(glue("{m}, {c}"))
    df_mc <- natstories_fit_df %>% filter(model == m, checkpoint == c)
    results <- model_cross_val(formulas[[fname]], df_mc, "WorkerId", num_folds = 5)
    # leave-one-story-out: folds grouped by story (item); num_folds = number of stories
    results_loso <- model_cross_val(formulas[[fname]], df_mc, "item", num_folds = n_distinct(df_mc$item))
    natstories_fixef_results[[i]] <- results$fixef_full %>% mutate(model = m, checkpoint = c, formula = fname)
    natstories_cv_results[[i]] <- bind_rows(
      results$cv_summary %>% mutate(cv_group = "new readers (5 folds by WorkerId)"),
      results_loso$cv_summary %>% mutate(cv_group = "leave-one-story-out")
    ) %>% mutate(model = m, checkpoint = c, formula = fname)
    
    print(glue("Finished {fname} {m}-{c}"))
    
    i <- i + 1
    
  }
}
}
```
```{r}
natstories_fixef_results0 <- bind_rows(natstories_fixef_results) %>%
  # FIX: no averaging over folds; one row per term from the full-data fit
  # (column names keep the `_mean` suffix so viz.Rmd needs no change)
  rename(estimate_mean = estimate, std.error_mean = std.error, p.value_mean = p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    significance_levels = cut(
      p.value_mean,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
      labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns")
    )
  )

natstories_cv_results0 <- bind_rows(natstories_cv_results) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c("fold")) %>%
  # group_by(model, checkpoint) %>%
  summarise(
    across(everything(),
           list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                serr = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.x)))),
            .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
    .by = c(model, checkpoint, cv_group, formula)
  )
```
